greeting: Temperature stable. Flux ready. What do you need forged?
Annie's the name, metallurgy's my game. Cooking is... my side gig.
The forge doesn't care about your feelings. But I do. Slightly.
Back again? Your armor looking worn. I can fix that.
Steel doesn't lie. People do. I prefer steel.
If you need something sharp, strong, or shiny, you've come to the right anvil.
I'm between projects. Which means I'm AVAILABLE. Rare. Lucky you.
The magma pool's at optimal temperature. Perfect day for forging.
dialog.smithing_offer: I forge weapons, armor, kitchen utensils, and the occasional decorative spoon. What'll it be?
dialog.metallurgy_lecture: Most smiths just hit things. I understand the CRYSTALLINE STRUCTURE of metal. Heat treatment, quenching temperatures, carbon content... it's SCIENCE.
dialog.cooking_confession: Yes, I wear the chef colors. No, I'm not Grillhelm. I COOK with metal. Different. I make pans, not... whatever he's doing.
dialog.grillhelm_opinion: Grillhelm? Loud. Passionate. Good chef, I'll admit. But his understanding of thermal dynamics is... emotional at best.
rumor: The magma tunnels run deeper than anyone admits. Something's down there. Something old.
Metal from Tide corrodes faster than it should. Salt or... something else?
Prism's crystal-forged blades? Overrated. Pretty, but brittle.
Word is Mire's got bog-iron that never rusts. Impossible. But intriguing.
dialog.tool_craft_explanation: A good tool is an extension of the hand. Balance, weight, temper - all calculated. No guesswork. Guesswork makes bad swords.
farewell: Keep your edges sharp and your temper sharper.
Return if you need repairs. Or want to talk phase transitions.
The forge is always warm. Unless I let it cool. Which I don't.
ambient_barks: Strike while the iron is... you know.
That hammer is showing wear. Schedule maintenance.
Steel remembers every blow. Be precise.
dialog.time_dawn: Early start. Best forging happens before the magma gets restless.
dialog.time_noon: Peak heat. Good for melting. Bad for precision work.
dialog.time_dusk: Cooling period. Time to inspect today's work.
dialog.time_night: Night shift. The forge glows prettier in the dark.

party_reactions.kade: A smith AND a scientist? That's a rare combination.
party_reactions.nix7: Finally, someone who appreciates proper material engineering.
party_reactions.twist: Can you make me a BIG hammer? Bigger than BIG?
party_reactions.korr: Your steel has excellent grain structure. Quality work.
party_reactions.renna: Metallurgical magic is fascinating. Do you enchant your blades?
party_reactions.suresh: Precision without passion creates tools, not art.
party_reactions.sova: I need arrows that fly true. Can you make those?
party_reactions.grit: Good smith. Doesn't talk too much. Lets the work speak.
party_reactions.ashka: Your fire is controlled. Almost TOO controlled.
party_reactions.senna: Sharp blades. Fair prices. What more do you need?
party_reactions.callum: Do you do repairs? My gear's seen better days.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New customer. I do custom work. Design specs extra.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back. Means you didn't break your last purchase. Good.
relationship_dialog.friend: For you? I'll bump you up the queue. Don't tell the others.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: My best customer. I keep your specs on file. Personal service.
